method: Verified manifest, source/evidence/dataset hashes; request-key and task/call correspondence; raw response identity and final parsed output; exact local reconstruction of every adaptive request using saved bodies only; original and independent scores; raw usage and accounting; existing inputs hashed before/after.
billingScope: Zero unresolved request intents and complete provider-reported costs. Offline receipts cannot independently reconcile an external billing statement.
latencyScope: Original saved strategy latency includes client, retrieval, summary and answer time; may include checkpoint replay. Durable intent/receipt deltas shown separately; these contain transport/body time, not server-only time.
